title: inbox check_json_depth silently accepts malformed JSON
description: src/inbox.rs:31-65. check_json_depth() does a pass over raw bytes to detect nesting depth before parsing. It handles string escaping and bracket tracking, but doesn't validate JSON structure — e.g. it would accept 'foo{{{' as depth 3. This is intentional (it's a pre-filter, not a parser), but a brief doc comment explaining that it's a deliberate false-negative-safe pre-check, not a JSON validator, would prevent future maintainers from mistaking it for a validation function.
